response.overview: Peace Raiders follows a South Sudanese initiative to reopen long-closed routes, rebuilding connections and strengthening relationships. In February 2026, youth, chiefs, women leaders and local authorities set out on foot to reopen routes linking communities between Jonglei and Greater Pibor. For days they walked together across the wilderness and former conflict frontlines, with a determination that these pathways through the wilderness can be restored to their peaceful purpose.
response.title: Peace Raiders
